summary: Saavedra et al. 2023 (Nat Commun), 10x single-nucleus RNA-seq of dissected adult male thoraces (GEO GSE227038); replaces the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0006361 with fresh VFBseq ids. Driver-only controls (tub-Gal80ts/+ ; dMef2-GAL4/+) only: 1 Sample / 2 technical-replicate Assays, linked to the GAL4 and GAL80ts alleles (GENO has_genotype). One Clustering with the authors' 17 clusters (all genotypes integrated) restricted to the 14,170 control nuclei, from the authors' GEO metadata: 14 loaded (adult muscle, glia, neuron, fat, trachea, hemocyte, epithelial and salivary gland cell terms), 3 'Unknown cluster' held. Summary expression as CPM from the control libraries (16,489 genes x 14,170 nuclei).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.
Controls only (the driver-only cross); the REPTOR and FoxO muscle overexpression samples left out; the authors' 17 clusters (all genotypes integrated) restricted to the control nuclei.

One Sample with two Assays (methods: one nuclei preparation per genotype in two 10x channels, 'technical replicates'; sample_groups); adult stage (GEO gives no age; about 1-2 weeks); adult thorax; male; the cross linked to Scer\GAL4[Mef2.PU] (FBal0288220) and Scer\GAL80[ts.alphaTub84B] (FBal0147425).
Clusters by build_clusters.py from the authors' GEO per-nucleus metadata (all 45,335 nuclei); 'Unknown cluster' held (untyped).

Mapping per author type: adult cell terms; cell body glia narrowed to the VNC (exact: CNS-only), perineurial glia not (the thorax's peripheral nerves); ventral / peripheral nervous system to adult VNC / PNS neuron and the salivary gland to adult salivary gland epithelial cell (broad: tissue types to their main cell type).
The thorax-only adipose cluster (adult fat cell) to move to 'adult postcephalic fat cell' when FBbt #2218 is fixed and released (tracked in checks/pending_fbbt_requests.json).

Expression from the two control libraries' GEO matrices side by side (combine_matrices.py), as CPM; the metadata's per-library aggregation suffixes mapped to GEO's -1 barcodes; FBgn ids mapped to current FlyBase genes (16,412 current, 80 secondary, 3 merges; 1 split and 2 withdrawn dropped).
All 17 mapping.tsv rows reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).
